caption: Castello di Miramare, Trieste
composition: White Miramare Castle on the Adriatic cliff · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the water off the promontory on a bright morning, looking at the white Castello di Miramare above the sea. The neo-Gothic castle fills the center of the frame atop its rocky cliff, umbrella pines and cypresses crowding the slope to the right, while the open Adriatic stretches blue to the left. The modelled 23 September 2026, 09:50 light is clear and summery, the white stone glowing against the turquoise water below.
